/agreements/{agreementId}/convert/html.summary: Path used to convert an agreeement to HTML format.
/agreements/{agreementId}/convert/html.description: The REST endpoint/path used convert or render an `agreement` to HTML format.

/agreements/{agreementId}/trigger.summary: Path used to trigger an agreeement.
/agreements/{agreementId}/trigger.description: The REST endpoint/path used trigger an `agreement`.

requestBody.description: Incoming data — a JSON serialized Concerto type

200.description: Successful response - returns the result of calling a function.

post.description: Sends data to an existing agreement.

/templates/archive.summary: Path used to create a template from a .cta archive.
/templates/archive.description: The REST endpoint/path used to create a `Template` by uploading a Cicero Template Archive (`.cta`) file directly, instead of the pre-parsed JSON shape accepted by `POST /templates`.

201.description: The template was created (or, if an identical archive already exists, the existing template was returned).

400.description: The uploaded file is missing or is not a valid `.cta` archive.

422.description: The archive's declared Cicero compatibility range is not satisfied by the Cicero version this server supports.

post.summary: Create a template from a .cta archive
post.description: Parses an uploaded `.cta` archive and creates a `Template`, rejecting archives whose declared Cicero version range does not match the version of Cicero supported by this server.

/agreements/{agreementId}/terms.summary: Path used to fetch the byte-pinned terms document for an agreement.
/agreements/{agreementId}/terms.description: The REST endpoint/path used to fetch the Legal Context Protocol terms artifact for an `agreement` — a deterministic Markdown rendering of the agreement text. The response is the exact byte sequence that `atrHash` on `/agreements/{agreementId}/legal-context` authenticates.

404.description: No agreement exists with the given id.

get.description: Fetch the byte-pinned Legal Context Protocol terms document for an existing agreement.

/agreements/{agreementId}/legal-context.summary: Path used to fetch the Legal Context Protocol document for an agreement.
/agreements/{agreementId}/legal-context.description: The REST endpoint/path used to fetch the resource-scoped Legal Context Protocol (legalcontextprotocol.org v1.0) discovery document for an `agreement`.

200.description: Successful response - returns the `LegalContext` document for the agreement.

404.description: No agreement exists with the given id.

get.description: Fetch the Legal Context Protocol discovery document for an existing agreement.

/capabilities.summary: Path used to retrieve server capabilities.
/capabilities.description: The REST endpoint used to understand the capabiities of the server.

200.description: Successful response - returns `capabilities` for the server.

get.description: Retrieve the supported features of the server.
